name: fleshmarket-tools
description: Dev tooling for the FleshMarket repo. The SERVER's manifest is server/package.json; this one exists only so the checks in tools/ have their dependencies declared instead of being installed by hand. jsdom is floored at 30 because fleet-check constructs a PointerEvent, which jsdom did not implement until well after 24, and an older one fails the check for a reason that has nothing to do with the code under test. canvas is OPTIONAL, not a devDependency: it is a native build that fails on plenty of machines, it is needed only by tools/citybattle-harness.mjs to draw frames headlessly, and nothing in client/ or server/ imports it - a failed optional install leaves that one tool SKIPPED and every other check running. Nothing here is deployed: ship.sh does a git pull and a pm2 restart and never runs npm at the repo root.
